Hi Paul — thanks for the PO and context. Congratulations on the expanded commitment. I’ve looped in Laura from billing and Michael from finance ops so we can get the entity change and payment flow documented. A few quick clarifying items so we can proceed without delay: 

1) Is the legal entity on the PO the final invoice entity you want on all invoices going forward? (Nemesis Health GmbH vs. any holding entity)
2) Please confirm the IBAN + BIC for SEPA or, if you prefer, whether you want a consolidated monthly invoice versus one per renewal milestone.
3) Net 45 is typically fine for renewals on approved contracts — finance will confirm, but expect a short PO review first.

Laura/Michael: can you advise on Redwood’s documentation requirements for EU entities (we typically need a completed invoice routing form plus VAT registration docs; we may also need a W-8BEN-E if there are US tax considerations). I’ve attached the PO Paul sent.

Next steps: Paul, once you send the signed PO + IBAN + VAT cert we’ll issue a billing change form to sign and confirm first invoice date.

— Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Paul / Sofia — thanks for the details and the routing form. I’m Laura from Redwood Billing; I’ll own the setup and confirm the first invoice schedule. A few notes and an ask: 

1) Good: PO NH-2026-03, Nemesis Health GmbH, VAT ID DE123456789, SEPA details captured.
2) Net 45: we can approve Net 45 for this renewal once a signed PO and the invoice routing form are on file. Our standard practice for non-US entities: we collect a completed W-8BEN-E (tax residency form) to document foreign status for tax records. Could you confirm you can provide that? If not, note there may be withholding implications.
3) Please sign the attached billing_change_form.pdf and return. That form confirms the invoice remit, the billing contact, and the preferred terms. Once we have the signed form + PO + VAT certificate + W-8BEN-E, we’ll: 
   - Update the billing entity in our system
   - Schedule the first invoice for March 31 (covering the committed capacity upfront) unless you request otherwise
   - Add Sofia as primary billing contact and set automated SEPA instructions (we’ll send a SEPA mandate link after confirmation)

Attachment: billing_change_form.pdf (pdf)

If you’d like Net 45 to kick in after the first invoice (i.e., invoice on March 31 with due date May 15), note that the SAP/AR team prefers consistency across the term — we can accommodate this request but need explicit sign-off on the billing_change_form.

Thanks — I’ll hold here until we have the signed docs.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
